newsitem.title: USA: Quigley producing $1.5 mln Cold-Eeze weekly.
newsitem.headline: Quigley producing $1.5 mln Cold-Eeze weekly.

text.p: Quigley Corp chief executive Guy Quigley said the company was currently producing $1.5 million worth of its Cold-Eeze zinc gluconate lozenges weekly, as new automation is in place to help keep up with burgeoning demand.
"For the rest of the cold season...we have it at the point where we're shipping $1.5 million a week," Quigley told an Emerald Asset Managment investment conference.
Demand for the product has soared in the wake of research findings last year that showed Cold-Eeze to be effective in treating the common cold.
